description: DegenHedge's public, graded record of its Kalshi BTC 15-minute alerts: every alert sent to subscribers with a 1-99 cent entry, graded against Kalshi's official result, losses included. Overall and by entry-price bucket: signals, wins, win rate with a Wilson 95% interval, average entry, breakeven before and after a one-contract fee, data-through date. The record sits below breakeven: report the win rate only together with its average entry price.

entry_price_bucket.description: Optional: return only this entry-price bucket (plus the overall line)

name: get_graded_record
